question: Which cell organelle appears as rounded or sausage - shaped structures under electron microscopy, measuring about 0.5 - 1.0 µm in diameter and 2 - 8 µm in length?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mitochondria**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mitochondria **are critical organelles within **eukaryotic cells.**
 
• They are often referred to as the **"powerhouses"**
